title: Union with Christ begins with learning the art of meditation
description: Bringing you the news from a traditional Catholic perspective. ( LifeSiteNews ) — When I sent a copy of my book Early Christian Spirituality to a friend, I also prayed that he would have the time to read it. My prayer was answered in a rather dramatic way that I do not think he appreciated. He found himself stranded at an airport for 24 hours with nothing better to do than to read my book! He summed up his reaction to the book with one single word, and that word was “time.” Where, oh where, do we get the time in the busy world in which we are living to do c … Next time I want to introduce you to someone who will tell you that this is not true. He will tell you authoritatively from his own experience. Then he will tell you how to pray in such a way that God, seeing your sincerity, and your seriousness, displayed by your genuine and daily perseverance, will lead you into contemplation far sooner than you ever thought possible.
